name: TOWN-EXIT-gate-faces-in
note: A gate's side read off the way its model faces IN: every gate's walk goes in through the wall behind it.

name: TOWN-EXIT-gate-flag-not-model
note: A gate read open by its flag: a block that laid it shut (its flag born open) is walked into.

name: TOWN-EXIT-gate-unrounded
old: x: Math.round(origin.x + m[12] / GLOBAL_SCALE), z: Math.round(origin.z + m[14] / GLOBAL_SCALE)
new: x: origin.x + m[12] / GLOBAL_SCALE, z: origin.z + m[14] / GLOBAL_SCALE
note: The gates read through the pixel-local Float32 matrices' noise, never whole units.

name: TOWN-EXIT-streets-never-open
old: if (x === 0 || y === 0 || x === W - 1 || y === H - 1) return { steps, open: true };
note: The streets never said open: the fields read as a town's streets.

name: TOWN-EXIT-no-street-test
note: A town whose streets run out to the edge (its ring not closed) is left by a gate from the fields.

name: TOWN-EXIT-no-street-reach
note: A traveller against a wall, in a cell its automap covers, is on no street.

name: TOWN-EXIT-no-yard-test
note: A yard no gate opens onto reads as a town with every gate shut.

name: TOWN-EXIT-shut-not-said
note: Every gate shut: no way out, and the journey leaves as before - into the wall.

name: TOWN-EXIT-through-a-shut-gate
note: A shut gate (a wall) is walked to and through.

name: TOWN-EXIT-gate-in-at-the-wall
note: The gate's inner and outer points on its wall.

name: TOWN-EXIT-out-on-the-road-line
old: ? { x: Math.min(L.xMax, Math.max(L.xMin, g.x)), z: at[g.side].z }
note: Out of a north or south gate straight to the side's road point, across the fields at a slant.

name: TOWN-EXIT-ring-always-clockwise
old: return lengthOf(start, ccw) < lengthOf(start, cw) ? ccw : cw;
note: The ring always walked clockwise, the long way round.

name: TOWN-EXIT-gate-by-the-ring-alone
note: The gate chosen by the ring alone: across the town to the far gate.

name: TOWN-EXIT-out-to-the-ring-on-the-road
note: The walk out to the ring's band at the road's rate.

name: TOWN-EXIT-legs-all-the-roads-kind
note: The walk in to the gate and through it at the road's rate.

name: TOWN-EXIT-legs-not-in-their-pixel
note: Every point of the way out aimed in the start pixel: the ring past an eight-block town never arrives.

name: TOWN-EXIT-legs-unmarked
note: The way out's legs unmarked: a resume in the town skips them, and joins a road between them.

name: TOWN-EXIT-shut-walked-anyway
note: The town's gates shut, and the journey begun anyway.

name: TOWN-EXIT-host-no-exit
old: ringAt: tvRingAt, exitAt: (x, y, to, me) => townExit(built.get(`${x},${y}`), tvTownRects(x, y), me, to) });
note: The host hands no way out.

name: TOWN-EXIT-host-shut-unsaid
note: The shut town refused in silence.

name: TOWN-EXIT-route-begun-shut
old:
const legs = tvJoinedLegs(from, plan, roads);
    if (!legs) return false;
note: A place's journey begun with no legs while the gates are shut - straight at the place, into the wall.

name: TOWN-EXIT-walk-begun-shut
old:
let legs = tvJoinedLegs(from, plan, roads);
    if (!legs) return false;
note: A spot's walk begun with no legs while the gates are shut (and `legs.length` read off null).
